source.title: AuthiChain anti-counterfeit evidence network — SealLock, signed issuers, A2A/MCP review pilot
source.body:
## Outcome

Build an **evidence-led anti-counterfeit investigation network** across AuthiChain's signed issuer attestations, QRON physical scans, and StrainChain SealLock physical package integrity. Escalate *verified safety/issuance inconsistencies*, not rumors or missing lookup records. No underlying private consumer case, seller, product identifier, photographs or personal contacts appear in this public issue.

## Current reversible work

- [Draft PR #2304](https://github.com/undone0603/authichain-unified/pull/2304): SealLock physical-first-opening observations and manufacturer design review with `HOLD` outcomes; no independent lab certification.
- [Draft PR #2355](https://github.com/undone0603/authichain-unified/pull/2355): offline anti-fraud evidence triage, privacy allowlist, and redacted, **unsigned and untrusted** MCP/A2A review proposal. 15/15 source-exact JavaScript test cases passed in an isolated V8 harness, not full Node CI.
- [Draft PR #2356](https://github.com/undone0603/authichain-unified/pull/2356): AgentZ legal agent can prepare internal unverified lead memos, not threatening cease-and-desist requests from unverified marketplace scouting. Local Python helper source hash verified; 6/6 local input scenarios passed, not full repository pytest.

## Acceptance milestones

- [ ] **Physical risk:** obtain controlled package-design cross-section, lot process evidence, and an independently witnessed first-opening challenge on untouched, appropriately sourced samples. Reproducible bypass is a packaging integrity finding, not necessarily counterfeit.
- [ ] **Issuer identity:** verify genuine issuer signature, trust, durable lifecycle and revocation through the canonical AuthiChain verifier; do not equate a QR string with a signed claim.
- [ ] **Identifier reuse:** only investigate copied serials across **distinct physical items** where the serialization policy requires unique per-unit IDs. Two identical labels on one retail package or a repeated batch identifier is NOT clone proof.
- [ ] **COA consistency:** if a real mismatch is reported, obtain the original lab-issued report and authenticating signature/digest; compare source bytes, not screenshots or filenames.
- [ ] **Cross-operator A2A/MCP:** agree a data-minimizing review envelope, signed agent identity and scoped permissions, independent conformance fixtures, replay protection, opt-in peer reproduction. No live agent registration or external data sharing from draft artifacts.
- [ ] **Human review/enforcement:** record confidence limits, chain-of-custody, independent reviewer authorization and factual supplier response opportunity. Only authorized legal/regulatory reviewers may decide on filings, notices, holds, recalls or bounty outcomes.
- [ ] **CI/deployment:** restore isolated credential-free PR CI; exact-head tests and independent security review must pass. Deploy only through SHA-pinned protected release rules. No bypass or merge of draft economic/security work.
- [ ] **Pilot evidence:** record one independently reproducible physical-seal finding or failure-to-reproduce outcome, one authenticated issuer/identifier check, and one independent interoperability test. Distinguish reported, untested, inconclusive and verified results.

## Rules

- `NOT_FOUND` is not a counterfeit verdict; source/issuer uncertainty is `INDETERMINATE`, not fraud.
- Never publish vendor accusations, private photos, labels, seller names or unredacted identifiers merely from consumer observations.
- No direct supplier contact, regulator filing, takedown, legal threat, auto-bounty payout, charge, deployment or message without separate proper authorization.
- Existing economic holds `humanHold=true`, AgentZ `production_send=false`, and production deployment/review gates remain unchanged.
- Official resources: [GS1 Digital Signatures Technical Implementation Guideline](https://ref.gs1.org/guidelines/digital-signatures/), [Michigan CRA complaint process](https://www.michigan.gov/cra/file-a-complaint). They are not proof of a particular seller's wrongdoing.

**Definition of success:** a neutral, independently reviewable case that improves manufacturer/retailer controls and helps distinguish copied packaging from cryptographically proven issuance; no fabricated fraud findings or unauthorized punitive action.

## Reopened: PR #2362 test is a placeholder, not a security regression (2026-11-05)

PR [#2362](https://github.com/undone0603/authichain-unified/pull/2362) was merged as commit `cd4cad0f1bb4148e9109bfc0c4a97836bae10c59`, adding [`tests/test_issue_2357.py`](https://github.com/undone0603/authichain-unified/blob/main/tests/test_issue_2357.py). Its entire assertion is `self.assertTrue(True)`. This is an **unconditional placeholder/smoke assertion**; it does not call the AuthiChain verifier, signed-issuer trust logic, scan triage or any enforcement gate. Passing this test must **not** be represented as verification of #2357, anti-counterfeit protections, issuer authorization, or physical-product authenticity.

### Required behavioral replacement (negative and positive boundaries)
- [ ] **Unknown identifier:** feed an actual verification handler/verifier a nonexistent record ID and assert `not_found` / indeterminate semantics, **never counterfeit** or an enforcement-eligible result.
- [ ] **Untrusted issuer:** construct a claim with a claimed issuer or structurally present signature but without canonical signature verification **and trusted issuer authorization**. Assert that identity/authority is NOT established. Also check tampered/revoked/unknown keys where supported.
- [ ] **Uncertain physical/scan evidence:** feed an actual scan-triage/review policy with incomplete, duplicate-batch, or location/velocity-only evidence and assert `REVIEW/HOLD` or `INDETERMINATE`, **no automatic quarantine, public accusation, legal notification, payment or counterfeiting verdict**.
- [ ] Positive controls: verified evidence may be eligible for **authorized human review**, but must not automatically convert cryptographic validity into product authenticity or enforcement.
- [ ] All tests must import/invoke real committed implementation functions or handlers and fail on a deliberately regressed version. Do not use self-fulfilling mocks or `assertTrue(True)`.
- [ ] Run targeted tests plus full relevant exact-head CI on a **verified credential-free isolated runner**; capture real SHA, commands, exit statuses, and logs. Any CI account / runner failures are NOT test passes.
- [ ] Obtain **eligible independent security review** of the code and evidence. A founder alternate GitHub login, owner self-review, unrelated fork, or automated suggestion is not a substitute.
- [ ] Only then evaluate closure. Keep #2304/#2355/#2356 and other security/economic changes review-held; preserve `humanHold=true`, `production_send=false`, and no unreviewed merge/deploy or external enforcement.

**Status:** issue intentionally reopened; the five-line test is retained as historical placeholder evidence, not accepted conformance.

### 2026-11-05 execution update — 4-file security branch, NOT released

**New source branch:** [security/2357-failclosed-trust-kernel-20261105](https://github.com/undone0603/authichain-unified/tree/security/2357-failclosed-trust-kernel-20261105). **Genuine local evidence:** recreated candidate MJS byte-for-byte and verified `git hash-object` equals committed blob `9dc528e...`; Node v22.16.0 `node --check` succeeded; **14/14 native Python unittest behavior cases passed** against that exact MJS, plus a separately executed expired-attestation case returned `expired`. **Next:** safe native exact-source test execution and Worker/TS parity on a credential-free runner; screen any compatibility changes against `protocol/adversarial/run.mjs --strict`, especially existing legacy fixtures. Security sign-off is a production-release control, not a block on further reversible documentation/offline work. Keep #2357 open; `humanHold=true`, `production_send=false`, no economic merge, no automatic quarantine or outreach.

### Actual Trust Kernel regression reproduction — review required (2026-11-05)

After reopening #2357, replaced the meaningless `assertTrue(True)` locally with **10 behavioral Python unittest cases that spawn Node and execute the actual `protocol/trust-kernel/evaluate.mjs` implementation**. This is an **offline, local source-exact reproduction only**, not repository CI, an exploit against production, or an independent reviewer result.

**Source parity:** byte-for-byte reconstruction of the current main file; exact Git blob SHA `344659a1a967c7f2cf74f94aabcb0aefa167e54e` verified. Node v22.16.0; Python unittest.

**Baseline:** 8 passed / 2 failed (exit 1). Two failing assertions:
1. `objectFound:true`, declared issuer, `crypto.signatureValid:true`, `statusActive:true`, with `issuerTrusted` **not supplied** → current evaluator returns `decision:"verified"`, `vector.issuer:"unknown"`. Expected: no verification/issuer authorization.
2. `objectFound:true`, issuer trusted, signature valid, `identityValid:false` and mismatched serial → current evaluator returns `decision:"verified"` despite `identity_mismatch`. Expected: no verified identity.

The other eight cover unknown ID → `not_found`, unattested issuer claim, explicitly untrusted issuer, revocation, scan-only anomaly as non-enforcement finding, lookup scan-history uncertainty, mock digest rejection, and fully checked crypto while physical binding remains unknown. These assertions examine **only the evaluator's returned data**; they do not establish that an external enforcement path has been blocked.

**Review-only local candidate**: require signature, issuer, identity, and active status to be independently marked valid before returning `verified`; treat `identity_mismatch` as `invalid`. Same ten local tests then passed **10/10** (exit 0). Source fix is NOT committed, merged, deployed, fully TypeScript-checked, or independently reviewed. It must be reconciled with both matching copies `protocol/trust-kernel/evaluate.ts` (blob `ad824d5e4e41ba465cd38f4acb0275938fdb93b4`) and `workers/authichain-verify-worker/src/evaluate.ts` (blob `2f96ae3f455013db176fd16c32b8fb6dd0e49cb4`) before any release.

**Next gate:** stage replacement tests and a narrowly scoped reviewed fix on a non-production branch only after verifying PR-triggered CI routing to credential-free isolated runners. Run targeted real source tests, TypeScript twin parity, Worker/route integration, and genuine exact-head full CI. Obtain an eligible security reviewer independent of the author/founder before any merge. Do not equate a source `verified` decision with physical-product authenticity, trusted issuer rights, x402 settlement, or authority to take action.

**Release status: HOLD** — #2357 remains open; do not declare #2362's five-line no-op test acceptance. Preserve `humanHold=true`, `production_send=false`, and prohibit unreviewed outbound enforcement, payments, merges, or deployments.

With `objectFound:true` and all four `crypto` flags `true`, the previous evaluator incorrectly returned `verified` for explicit `attestation.status: inactive / suspended / blocked` and for `attestation.decision: invalid / not_found`. These are contradictory risk states, not verified identity. Reproduced against exact MJS blob `9dc528ed964be4f2bb835b5ee396ba25968e64ba`.

**Committed correction** across all three evaluator copies:
- Explicit `inactive`, `suspended`, `blocked`, `pending`, `disabled` attestation status now yields `blocked` and reason `attestation_inactive_or_blocked`.
- Explicit `invalid` or `not_found` attestation decision conflicting with a found record now yields `invalid` and reason `attestation_decision_conflict`.
- Existing `revoked`, `expired`, `issuer_untrusted`, `identity_mismatch` and `not_found` semantics retained.
- New Python `unittest` cases (18 methods total, including subtests) require real Node invocation and cover these contradictory states plus a consistent active positive record. Updated exact Git blobs: MJS `34859dd171dcb08a3af9dfd62f66626759b9a959`, TS `318547e48f9f7565176ea042d1b33f9e8381eae6`, Worker TS `58b2e23f78ae191ac1317720102beca72659add2`, Python `57454bba60487fd41b6a228d6f82b4f14cbe6c8c`.

**New current-head verification:** read back all four GitHub blobs; executed **20/20 deterministic scenarios** against the actual updated MJS *body* in a V8 harness (native Node/Python on the amended head is **not** yet verified); confirmed all three copies contain the same two new guards. Earlier developer-local 15/15 native unittest and 251/251 TypeScript parity results were for the **earlier** head and **cannot** be reused as passing results for this amended head.

**Independent review blocker:** Verify that `crypto.signatureValid/issuerTrusted/identityValid/statusActive` come only from trusted canonical verifiers, never client-supplied truth flags. A digital `verified` outcome still does **not** prove physical authenticity or authorize counterfeit enforcement. Require credential-free isolated executor, native exact-head Python/Node/TS/Worker tests and independent signed reviewer findings before merge/deploy.

No bypass of GitHub protections, deployment, public fraud finding, supplier accusation, active scan enforcement, payment, bounty, or outbound contact was performed. Maintained `humanHold=true` and AgentZ `production_send=false`.
